Name: Bebber Bobbers
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
Bebber Bobbers allows mod authors to add new fishing bobbers to the game for the player to choose from in the bobber machine in Willy's shop. No more will you be limited to the usual 40 bobber styles the vanilla game offers and no more will you be forced to replace them if you want to add your own—now you can have as many bobbers in your game as you want, and either select them manually or use the random bobber selection, which will also select from bobbers added via Bebber Bobbers.

In order to facilitate a potentially infinite number of bobbers, Bebber Bobbers remakes the vanilla bobber selection menu to add pagination support via arrows on the left side. Rest assured, it continues to have full controller support.

Looking for an example? Check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36654]Pokéball Bobbers[/url].

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Usage For Players[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own. There is no benefit to installing this as a user if another mod that you are using does not require it.
